sentences.english: It is Saturday and it rains a lot.
It is windy and cold.

sentences.text: Hay menos sol y menos calor.
sentences.english: There is less sun and less heat.

sentences.text: En el verano hay sol y calor, pero hoy es invierno.
sentences.english: In the summer there is sun and heat, but today it is winter.
It is a month of rain.
Everyone is in the house.

sentences.text: Doña Marta dice: "Hoy me quedo en casa."
sentences.english: Doña Marta says: "Today I stay at home."
Sam is watching the rain.
He is alone in the room.

sentences.text: Está escribiendo un mensaje en su celular.
sentences.english: He is writing a message on his cell phone.

sentences.text: Sam dice: "Así es la vida aquí, con lluvia y viento."
sentences.english: Sam says: "This is life here, with rain and wind."

sentences.text: Doña Marta está cocinando frijoles y arroz.
sentences.english: Doña Marta is cooking beans and rice.

sentences.text: Tiene el pan en la mano.
sentences.english: She has the bread in her hand.

sentences.text: Nico está jugando con un juego pequeño.
sentences.english: Nico is playing with a small game.

sentences.text: Juega solo, porque no quiere leer.
sentences.english: He plays alone, because he does not want to read.
Luis is in bed.
He is sleeping.

sentences.text: Ana está escribiendo el aviso de la semana.
sentences.english: Ana is writing the notice for the week.

sentences.text: Tiene el celular en la mano.
sentences.english: She has the cell phone in her hand.
Luis is not sleeping any more.

sentences.text: Ana va al cuarto de Luis.
sentences.english: Ana goes to Luis's room.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Luis, how are you?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Are you better?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Ya no tengo fiebre, pero me duele la cabeza.
sentences.english: I no longer have a fever, but my head hurts.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: I have pain in my eyes.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: I am a little unwell.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: And your mouth?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Does it hurt?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: No, my mouth is fine.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: I am sick, nothing more.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Good.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I will give you water in a moment.
Nico does not want to be alone.
He goes to doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Grandmother, what is happening with the rain?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Nothing, Nico.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: La lluvia pasa y el sol llega.
sentences.english: The rain passes and the sun comes.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: I am hungry.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Is there bread?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Yes, here it is.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: There is not much bread left.
Nico eats.

sentences.text: Tiene pan en la mano y pan en la boca.
sentences.english: He has bread in his hand and bread in his mouth.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Now take the book, Nico.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Abuela, un juego es mejor que un libro.
sentences.english: Grandmother, a game is better than a book.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Yes, I know.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Pero leer es bueno para los ojos y para el corazón.
sentences.english: But reading is good for the eyes and for the heart.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Fine, grandmother.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Leo un poco, y el juego espera.
sentences.english: I read a little, and the game waits.

sentences.text: Ana llega con el celular en la mano.
sentences.english: Ana comes with the cell phone in her hand.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sam, ¿ves el aviso de la semana?
sentences.english: Sam, do you see the notice for the week?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Yes, I see the notice.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: What does it say?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Dice: "El sábado hay reunión en la iglesia.
sentences.english: It says: "On Saturday there is a meeting at church.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Favor enviar un mensaje al pastor."
sentences.english: Please send a message to the pastor."

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Is it going to rain on Saturday?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I do not know.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hoy llueve, pero el sábado no sé.
sentences.english: Today it rains, but I do not know about Saturday.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Así es el invierno en Honduras.
sentences.english: That is what winter is like in Honduras.

sentences.text: Sam llega a la casa con Ana.
sentences.english: Sam comes in with Ana.
Sam sees doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Doña Marta, do you love the rain?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Yes, Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: La lluvia es una ayuda de Dios.
sentences.english: The rain is a help from God.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Con la lluvia tengo paz en el corazón.
sentences.english: With the rain I have peace in my heart.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Usted cree que Dios envía la lluvia?
sentences.english: Do you believe God sends the rain?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Yes, I am a Christian.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Creo en Dios y creo en la gente.
sentences.english: I believe in God and I believe in people.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I believe in God too.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Good, Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Hoy te quedás en tu casa.
sentences.english: Today you stay in your home.

sentences.text: Todos pasan el sábado en la casa.
sentences.english: Everyone spends Saturday at home.

sentences.text: Así es el día de la familia.
sentences.english: That is how the family day goes.
Sam is happy.

sentences.text: Su vida aquí es nueva, pero ya es su casa.
sentences.english: His life here is new, but it is already his home.
